jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc: h3 🧡 About Alma /h3 p At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers. /p p Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt. /p p As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we ve empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. /p p With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we re just getting started! /p p nbsp; /p h3 👐 About the team /h3 p Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma s merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets. /p p strong We work AI-native, by design. /strong Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE. /p p strong We are rebuilding our GTM system /strong around five layers: market definition, signals, data amp; enrichment, decision amp; routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, a href= http://Customer.io Customer.io /a is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it. /p p strong You will join a team of 6 /strong with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation amp; Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth. /p p nbsp; /p p span class= notion-enable-hover data-token-index= 0 This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid. /span /p h3 💼 About the job /h3 p strong Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant /strong /p ul li Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven t taken a first payment, retention and win-back. /li li Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage). /li li Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them. /li /ul p strong Help drive Alma s move towards consumers /strong /p ul li Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You ll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you ll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers. /li li It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast. /li /ul p strong Lead the migration off HubSpot /strong /p ul li Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think a href= http://Customer.io Customer.io /a or another tool fits better, make the case. /li li Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way. /li li With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule. /li /ul p strong Measure what you ship /strong /p ul li Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates. /li li Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing. /li /ul p strong Be the CRM project lead across Revenue /strong /p ul li Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate. /li li Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue. /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 🗓️ Your first months /h3 ul li strong Months 1–3: /strong you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch. /li li strong By month 6: /strong onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing. /li /ul h3 🧰 You will work with /h3 ul li strong Lifecycle: /strong Braze, a href= http://Customer.io Customer.io /a or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off. /li li strong Revenue systems amp; data: /strong Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker /li li strong AI amp; delivery: /strong Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 🧩 About you /h3 p strong To succeed in this job /strong /p ul li 5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale. /li li A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes. /li li Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, a href= http://Customer.io Customer.io /a , Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset. /li li Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform. /li li Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving several teams without formal authority, and you know how to prioritise when everyone needs your time. /li li Excellent writing in native-level French (mandatory) and fluent English. /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong And it will be nice if you also /strong /p ul li Have set up Braze, a href= http://Customer.io Customer.io /a or a similar platform from scratch, or helped choose one. /li li Have set up email deliverability (sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warm-up). /li li Already use AI in your daily work for copy, QA or analysis. /li li Have worked in fintech, payments, a card launch, or with retail merchant networks. /li li Speak Spanish, Italian or German. /li /ul p em Don t meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. /em /p p nbsp; /p h3 🧘 What s in it for you /h3 ul li strong Impact /strong : 26,000 merchants in 10 countries, thousands of signed merchants still to activate, and a consumer audience to build. Every journey you ship shows up in TPV. /li li strong A clean start /strong : you join in time to weigh in on the platform and set it up properly (data model, deliverability, governance) instead of inheriting years of workflow debt. /li li strong Leverage /strong : an AI-native team and engineers next to you for the data plumbing, so you spend your time on segments, messages and results. /li li strong Team /strong : a Team Lead Growth who designed this way of working, and close partners in Sales, Account Management, Ops and Product Marketing. /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 🤑 Compensation amp; Benefits /h3 ul li strong Competitive salary /strong based on 12 months /li li strong Profit sharing and employee savings plan /strong /li li strong Health insurance /strong : strong 100% /strong covered by Alma including family package /li li strong Disability insurance /strong : strong 100% /strong covered by Alma /li li strong Sport /strong : partnerships with strong Gymlib /strong and strong Classpass /strong , or strong €30/month /strong reimbursement for your sports activities /li li strong Maternity/paternity leave /strong : salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks. /li li strong Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD) /strong : strong €544.80/year /strong (excluding full remote contracts) /li li strong Meal vouchers /strong : strong €10/day /strong , 50% covered by Alma /li li strong Mental health /strong : free access to MindDay platform /li li strong Paid time off /strong : 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts) /li li Access to our strong Learning amp; Development Platform /strong /li li strong 2 weeks of full remote possible /strong per year in summer /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 🎯 Interview Process /h3 ul li strong Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member /strong to understand your path, motivation amp; present you the role. /li li strong Video call with your future manager /strong to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions. /li li strong Case study (in house) with a panel of Revenue leaders /strong : design a lifecycle programme for a merchant segment, plus a hands-on exercise in a marketing automation tool. /li li strong 1 or 2 additional interviews /strong : meetings with Revenue stakeholders (Ops, Account Management, Product Marketing) to assess business sense and team fit. /li /ul p nbsp; /p h3 🌍 Diversity amp; Inclusion /h3 p em At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.desc: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. What you'll build and own Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth. Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it. Your experience 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product. Hands-on with a marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself. Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content. An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does. Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel. Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks. Nice to have Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better. Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili. Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment. Why Join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. jobs.desc: QA Engineer (Web, App Payments) Hybrid Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands Technology Job description About Us Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we've been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy: Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts. And our motto: One team. One dream. The Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to own quality across our web funnels, mobile app, and payment flows. In this role, you are the last line of defence before every release: you decide whether we ship, and you make sure fast iteration never comes at the cost of a broken checkout or a stuck subscription. You'll work hand in hand with our backend, frontend, and Flutter developers, as well as the Funnel Ops team, to validate critical user journeys, reproduce the edge cases nobody else can, and steadily replace manual checks with automation. This is an AI-enabled role: you'll use AI tooling to generate test cases, speed up bug reproduction, and write automation scripts, so you spend more time on the hard problems and less on repetition. Key Responsibilities Own release QA: build test plans and regression suites, and make the go/no-go call for every release. Validate our critical flows end to end: onboarding, paywalls, checkout, payments, and subscription state transitions. Reproduce and document bugs clearly, coordinate fixes with engineering, and verify resolutions before they ship. Grow our automation coverage: automate repetitive tests, maintain release checklists, and drive down escaped defects. Classify bug severity and set the escalation path within QA's scope. Document QA processes and playbooks in Confluence so quality practices scale with the team. Use AI-enabled tooling to accelerate test coverage, bug reproduction, and scripting. Job requirements What We're Looking For You are structured but pragmatic. You like breaking things on purpose, you don't sign off on something you haven't seen work, and you stay calm when a release is on the line. Must-haves: 3+ years of experience in QA or test engineering for web and/or mobile products. Hands-on experience testing payment and subscription flows with modern providers (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, or similar): checkout, card and wallet payments, 3DS, trials, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and working with test modes and webhooks. Experience building automated UI tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar, in JavaScript/TypeScript. Able to investigate unstable runs, fix flaky tests, and tell a broken test from a broken product. Experience testing mobile applications (including Flutter) and web applications in browsers and in-app browsers, using real device clouds such as BrowserStack or LambdaTest. Comfortable working with APIs and verifying behaviour through data: REST and GraphQL, querying services and admin tools, and checking analytics events. Strong bug reporting skills: clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, and root-cause thinking. Comfortable making and defending release readiness decisions with engineering and product stakeholders; experience in cross-functional teams with frequent releases. Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken. Nice-to-haves: Analytics and event verification: Mixpanel, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel. Familiarity with products where a web funnel sells a subscription plus upsells, with content delivered via mobile and web apps. Experience with quiz-based funnels and performance marketing traffic. CI and reporting: Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Allure, or similar. Experience running load tests. Experience using AI assistants for test generation, debugging, and QA workflows. What Makes You Successful Here At Creative Clicks, our top performers: Take initiative and ownership. Focus on solutions, not obstacles. Stay grounded, even under pressure. Collaborate closely with their teams. Continuously deepen their expertise to inspire others. What We Offer A highly dynamic and fast-growing working environment. An international company with more than 25 nationalities. Competitive salary and fully paid commuting expenses. 25 days of annual leave (plus the option to buy 10 more), with a healthy work-life balance and hybrid work setup. A place to learn, discover, and develop yourself. Warm daily lunch in the office. A fun, ambitious, and young team of colleagues. A recently renovated, beautiful office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein in Amsterdam. Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors. Apply Now Ready to be the reason our releases ship with confidence? Apply now and join us at Creative Clicks.
